title: Fold a T-shirt in two seconds
summary: The Japanese pinch-and-cross fold: three pinch points on one line, one crossover, one lift.

workspace.notes: Tape an 80 x 60 cm outline. Calibrate by pinching its near-left corner, then its near-right corner. Lay the shirt face up inside it with the collar on the LEFT. The dot positions are first guesses for an adult M shirt: tune them on site.

objects.label: shoulder dot
objects.description: On the near shoulder, halfway between the collar and the sleeve seam.

objects.label: middle dot
objects.description: Halfway down the shirt, in line with the shoulder dot.

objects.label: hem dot
objects.description: On the bottom hem, in line with the other two dots.

objects.label: below the middle dot
objects.description: Mistake zone: a right-hand pinch here means the middle pinch is too close to you.

steps.instruction: Lay the shirt flat in the outline, face up, collar on the left.

success.prompt: The shirt lies flat inside the outline with the collar on the left

steps.coachNotes: Ask them to say ready when it is flat. You may also see it in the camera frames.

steps.instruction: With your left hand, pinch the shirt at the shoulder dot.

mistakes.message: Use your left hand for the shoulder dot.

steps.instruction: Keep holding. With your right hand, pinch the middle dot.

mistakes.message: Slide your right hand up to the dot.

steps.coachNotes: This is where the planted demo mistake happens: pinching too close to the near edge.

steps.instruction: Cross your left hand over your right and pinch the hem dot.
steps.detail: Your left hand keeps holding the shoulder fabric and brings it to the hem.
steps.coachNotes: Hardest step. Tracking can flicker while the hands cross, so the radii are loose on purpose. Offer show_demo early.

steps.instruction: Lift both hands, uncross them, and lay the shirt down folded.

of.prompt: The shirt is folded and lying flat

steps.coachNotes: Celebrate when it is done. If the fold is messy, offer to go again.

coach.persona: Upbeat and brief, like a friend showing off a party trick.
coach.notes: Say each instruction in under 12 words. Never guess where the hands are; trust the [app] messages.
